boroughs.name: Manhattan
boroughs.description: Manhattan is the most densely populated borough of New York City and the economic and administrative center of the city.

boroughs.name: Brooklyn
boroughs.description: Brooklyn is the most populous borough of New York City, known for its cultural diversity, independent art scene, and distinct neighborhoods.

boroughs.name: Queens
boroughs.description: Queens is the largest and most ethnically diverse borough in New York City, offering a rich tapestry of cultures and cuisines.

boroughs.name: The Bronx
boroughs.description: The Bronx is the northernmost borough of New York City, known for Yankee Stadium, the Bronx Zoo, and the New York Botanical Garden.

boroughs.name: Staten Island
boroughs.description: Staten Island is the southernmost borough of New York City, offering a more suburban feel with parks, beaches, and historic sites.
